title: Deployment
viz_content: SELECT replace_all(deployment_id, char(39), '') AS deployment FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - 30d AND deployment_id != '' GROUP BY deployment_id ORDER BY max(event_time) DESC LIMIT 50

title: Sessions over time by agent
description: Sessions with at least one event in each period, per agent.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(agent_id)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, agent_id, uniq(session_id) AS sessions FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY time, agent_id ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: Tokens over time by agent
description: Input plus output tokens over time, per agent.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(agent_id)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, agent_id, to_int64(sum(metric_value)) AS tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens') GROUP BY time, agent_id ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: Tokens by agent and model
description: Input plus output tokens per agent, split by model: the ten agents using the most.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(agent_id), ' ', to_string(model)) AS k FROM (SELECT agent_id, tags['model'] AS model, to_int64(sum(metric_value)) AS tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens') AND agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND metric_name IN ('llm.input_tokens', 'llm.output_tokens') GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY sum(metric_value) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY agent_id, model ORDER BY tokens DESC) ORDER BY tokens DESC

title: Tool calls by agent
description: Finished tool calls per agent, split into calls that worked and calls that failed: the ten agents making the most.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(agent_id), ' ', to_string(outcome)) AS k FROM (SELECT agent_id, if(tool_success, 'ok', 'failed') AS outcome, count() AS calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete' AND agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete' GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY agent_id, outcome ORDER BY calls DESC) ORDER BY calls DESC

title: Usage by agent
description: The eight most active agents in the selected window: when they were seen, and what they did.
viz_content: SELECT e.agent_id AS agent_id, e.deployment AS deployment, e.agent_types AS agent_types, e.first_event AS first_event, e.last_event AS last_event, e.sessions AS sessions, e.prompts AS prompts, e.tool_calls AS tool_calls, e.failed_calls AS failed_calls, m.model_requests AS model_requests, to_int64(m.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, to_int64(m.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, d.detections AS detections FROM (SELECT agent_id, any(deployment_id) AS deployment, array_string_concat(array_sort(group_uniq_array(to_string(agent_type))), ', ') AS agent_types, min(event_time) AS first_event, max(event_time) AS last_event, uniq(session_id) AS sessions, count_if(event_type = 'user_input') AS prompts, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete' AND NOT tool_success) AS failed_calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY agent_id) AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT agent_id, count_if(metric_name = 'llm.call') AS model_requests, sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens') AS input_tokens, sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.output_tokens') AS output_tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY agent_id) AS m ON m.agent_id = e.agent_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT agent_id, count() AS detections FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_security_events) WHERE detected_at > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY agent_id) AS d ON d.agent_id = e.agent_id ORDER BY sessions DESC, tool_calls DESC LIMIT 8

title: Usage by deployment
description: The eight most active deployments in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT e.deployment AS deployment, e.agents AS agents, e.sessions AS sessions, e.prompts AS prompts, e.tool_calls AS tool_calls, e.failed_calls AS failed_calls, m.model_requests AS model_requests, to_int64(m.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, to_int64(m.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, e.last_event AS last_event FROM (SELECT to_string(deployment_id) AS deployment, uniq(agent_id) AS agents, uniq(session_id) AS sessions, count_if(event_type = 'user_input') AS prompts, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete' AND NOT tool_success) AS failed_calls, max(event_time) AS last_event FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY deployment) AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_string(deployment_id) AS deployment, count_if(metric_name = 'llm.call') AS model_requests, sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens') AS input_tokens, sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.output_tokens') AS output_tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY deployment) AS m ON m.deployment = e.deployment ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 8
